M-KNOWLEDGE-SCHEMA.Purpose: Mechanically validate FLI knowledge nodes: tier matrix conformance, statement grammar, numbering, and FQID addressing.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Validation of XML node content against the tier/statement schema.

Requirements.REQ-001: Root tag must match the node ID pattern of a known tier (`P-*`, `S-*`, `SS-*`, `M-*`, `V-*`).
Requirements.REQ-002: Container fields must be within the tier's allowed field set; unknown fields are diagnosed.
Requirements.REQ-003: Statement prefixes are closed: SCP-IN, SCP-OUT, PRIN, TECH, REQ, IN, OUT, EFF, SCN; unregistered prefixes are diagnosed.
Requirements.REQ-004: Statement numbers are three-digit and incremental within their container; `Purpose` is direct text; absent side effects use `<SideEffects><None /></SideEffects>`.
Requirements.REQ-005: Every scenario's `target` attribute must resolve to a valid FQID form `NODE-ID.STATEMENT-ID`.
Requirements.REQ-006: Codemap must be wrapped in CDATA; content is restricted to identifiers and relation operators.

Inputs.IN-001: Knowledge file content as strict UTF-8 text.

Outputs.OUT-001: `KnowledgeValidation` with valid flag and error list.
